title: Shcare self-service password change request
description: POST /v1/me/password body. Both secrets are opaque exact values: clients and servers must not trim, normalize, echo or log them. Authentication establishes the account owner; Idempotency-Key is a required HTTP header and is never accepted in this body.

currentPassword.description: The current password exactly as entered, including leading or trailing whitespace. Never trim, normalize, echo, persist in an operation record or log.

newPassword.description: The new password exactly as entered. It must differ from currentPassword and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit. Never trim, normalize, echo, persist in an operation record or log.
